today.title: Daily Cockpit (Today)
today.summary: This screen centralizes your daily study plan calculated automatically from your SM-2 forgetting curve and recent practice history.
today.step1: 1. Select your target certification at the top to tailor today’s cards and questions.
today.step2: 2. Launch “Your Daily Session”: due SM-2 flashcards, fragile concepts, and targeted MCQs.
today.step3: 3. Hover or click the (?) tooltips to inspect every metric or open the official exam blueprint.

catalogue.title: 6 Cloud & AI Certifications Catalog
catalogue.summary: Browse, filter, and compare 6 official certifications across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and IBM watsonx to plan your learning track.
catalogue.step1: 1. Filter by Cloud provider, certification level (Fundamental, Associate, Expert), or domain (GenAI, MLOps).
catalogue.step2: 2. Click “Compare” to evaluate exam duration, passing scores, and domain weights side by side.
catalogue.step3: 3. Open any certification’s Blueprint or AI Tutor to review its full official syllabus.

recommendation.title: AI Recommendation Engine & Pathways
recommendation.summary: Generate a tailored certification roadmap from Level 1 to Level 4 based on your role, budget, and weekly study availability.
recommendation.step1: 1. Fill in or update your 7 profile criteria (job role, goal, budget, and weekly time).
recommendation.step2: 2. Review recommended pathways and prerequisite certifications step by step.
recommendation.step3: 3. Adopt any certification as your active goal to synchronize your daily cockpit and analytics.

quiz.title: Scenario MCQs & Pitfall Breakdown
quiz.summary: Train on realistic exam scenarios with instant validation, architectural explanations, and analysis of subtle vendor distractors.
quiz.step1: 1. Read the technical scenario carefully and pick option A, B, C, or D before validating.
quiz.step2: 2. After validation, inspect why incorrect choices represent classic certification exam traps.
quiz.step3: 3. Flag tricky questions with the bookmark icon or ask the AI Tutor for deeper clarification.

flashcards.title: Flashcards & SM-2 Spaced Repetition
flashcards.summary: Lock in service quotas, SLAs, SDK commands, and golden exam rules using the SuperMemo-2 spaced repetition engine (2,800 cards).
flashcards.step1: 1. Start with today’s due queue or filter cards by exam domain and difficulty status.
flashcards.step2: 2. Flip the card (Space) and honestly rate your recall: Again (1), Hard (2), Good (3), Easy (4).
flashcards.step3: 3. Optimal intervals (Day +1, +3, +7…) are saved automatically for upcoming study days.

exam.title: Timed Mock Exam Simulator
exam.summary: Test your pacing and endurance under authentic testing-center conditions (65 questions, 700 / 1,000 passing scale).
exam.step1: 1. Monitor the countdown timer in the top-right corner and pause only when needed.
exam.step2: 2. Flag uncertain questions for review and jump between numbers using the 65-question navigator grid.
exam.step3: 3. Submit the exam to get your scaled 1,000-point score and domain-by-domain breakdown.

glossary.title: Multi-Cloud AI Glossary & Encyclopedia
glossary.summary: Look up exact definitions, acronyms, and cross-cloud exam pitfalls across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and IBM.
glossary.step1: 1. Search any term or acronym (RAG, LoRA, Drift) or filter alphabetically and by provider.
glossary.step2: 2. Switch to the “In-Depth Encyclopedia” tab to read full architectural reference sheets.
glossary.step3: 3. Bookmark essential terms to revisit them rapidly right before exam day.

analytics.title: Dashboard & Cognitive Analytics
analytics.summary: Track your live exam readiness index, historical mock exam attempts, and mastery levels across every certification domain.
analytics.step1: 1. Select a certification from the matrix to inspect its up-to-date readiness metrics.
analytics.step2: 2. Open the “Exams” tab to revisit full reports from previous mock exam simulations.
analytics.step3: 3. Spot domains below 70% to focus your next targeted quizzes and SRS flashcards.

assistant.title: Pedagogical AI Assistant & Tutor
assistant.summary: Clarify cloud AI services, exam pitfalls, or mathematical metrics instantly using structured guides and Socratic prompts.
assistant.step1: 1. Pick your target certification and select a syllabus topic from the left panel.
assistant.step2: 2. Switch between Concepts, Exam Traps, and Mnemonics, or ask a custom question.
assistant.step3: 3. Jump directly into practice quizzes or flashcards to reinforce what you just learned.

profile.title: My Profile, Goals & GDPR Compliance
profile.summary: Manage your learner identity, active certification target, Firestore Cloud synchronization, and full personal data export.
profile.step1: 1. Edit your display name or sign in with Google to sync study progress across devices.
profile.step2: 2. Choose your priority certification goal from the active tracks list.
profile.step3: 3. Open “Help & GDPR” to inspect stored data and export your learning history as JSON.

audit.title: Content Audit & Editorial Governance
audit.summary: Administrator workspace to inventory, source-ground, AI-audit, and human-validate all pedagogical content.
audit.step1: 1. Review real inventory counters and priority alerts on the Dashboard.
audit.step2: 2. Run deterministic or AI-assisted audits and verify official documentation links.
audit.step3: 3. Human-review, edit, or roll back items in Validations before live publishing.
